name: wp-lab
description: Local WordPress lab for testing plugins and themes.

interface.shortDescription: Run a local WordPress sandbox for plugins and themes.
interface.longDescription: WP Lab gives Codex a local WordPress sandbox workflow with Docker Compose, mounted plugin and theme folders, automatic first-run WordPress setup, and scripts for starting, stopping, resetting, and opening the test site.
